'''N6-BC''' was a [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" /> In [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR dates|4}}</ref> the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]], during the [[Battle of Ilum|battle]] that took place there. On Ilum the droid operated a stall in the [[Republic base camp]], from which it sold various weapon modifications. N6-BC had [[Color/Legends|red]] plating and yellow [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
N6-BC appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Mods Vendor for Republic players on Ilum.<ref name="TOR" /> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> N6-BC was removed from the game along with the rest of the Mods Vendors.<ref name="TOR" /> His position is also marked on a map in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', a game guide released by [[Prima Games]].<ref name="Explorer">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>
